name: orchestrator-portal
description: A local-first command centre for personal AI assistants.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @orchestrator/contracts && npm run build -w @orchestrator/adapter-sdk && npm run build -w @orchestrator/web && npm run build -w @orchestrator/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @orchestrator/server" "npm run dev -w @orchestrator/web"
scripts.dev:demo: cross-env ORCHESTRATOR_DEMO=1 concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @orchestrator/server" "npm run dev -w @orchestrator/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @orchestrator/contracts && npm run build -w @orchestrator/adapter-sdk && npm run typecheck -w @orchestrator/server && npm run typecheck -w @orchestrator/web
